rationale: Preserve Valley of Fire unchanged and defer its ownership correction. Primary manager and company sources support Valley of Fire Solar, LLC as a distinct solar-and-storage holdco and identify the 2024 continuation vehicle, but the complete current cap table is not public. A March 2026 filing discloses an individual security holder without the security class or percentage, so a complete current ownership after-image cannot be stated safely.

evidence.purpose: Official 2024 continuation-vehicle and Valley of Fire transaction evidence.
Official current Valley of Fire platform and project profile.
